name: Folder open
what: A desktop folder pops in, a cursor glides to it and double-clicks, and a window grows out of it with a grid of pictures popping in - a portfolio, a project, behind the scenes; it can close back at the end.

learned_from.what: a cursor double-clicking a folder that opens into a picture window

motion: folder back.out 12 f; the cursor glides 24 f (a curve), double-click (2 dips of 3 f); the window grows 16 f (slow end), pictures 3 f apart; closes 12 f
